result.title: Live Animals & Germinals Data Fields - V4
result.body:
This page outlines the agreed data fields required for the EUDP Live Animal journey, along with their defined characteristics and business rules

panel_c1

All fields apply to both the animal and germinal journeys. Any field that applies to only one is marked as such. Where a field applies to both but the permitted values differ, the values are listed by journey.

Live Animal Data Elements

Note: ‘Applies at’ shows whether the field is entered once for the notification or is driven by commodity selection. Notification level means the field is entered once for the notification and is not driven by commodity selection.

The Data captured applies at different levels:

Level 1: Notification — one movement event. Reason for import, transport, parties, Place of Destination, Border Control Post, gross weight. Things that are true of the whole consignment.
Level 2: Commodity line — 1..N per notification. A commodity code plus its taxonomy chain (Type, Class, Species) plus a quantity. Things that are true of a specific commodity.
Level 3: Unit record — 0..N per line. Identifiers for an individual animal or germinal product — ear tag, passport, donor name/ID, collection date. Things that are true per unit.
